$comment: Cloudflare Cache Rules for the website API (S7-06, ADR 0012 #5; runbook docs/runbooks/cdn.md). Applied to the zone's http_request_cache_settings entrypoint by `pnpm ops:cdn-rules --env <staging|production> --apply`, which replaces only the rules whose ref starts with `inmolink_` and keeps every other rule. ${FEED_API_HOST} is the destination's proxy.host in infra/kamal/feed-api.<env>.yml. Every plan: Vary handling in Cache Rules and purge by tag are available on Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise (custom header cache keys are Enterprise-only, so the key goes into the cache key through the origin's Vary).

rules.description: Website API v2 reads: cache what the origin marks public (s-maxage, stale-while-revalidate, stale-if-error 24 h), keyed by URL (with the _k key token, sorted query) and by the X-Api-Key and Authorization values; any other Vary header (Origin included) bypasses the cache
rules.expression: (http.host eq "${FEED_API_HOST}" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v2/") and http.request.method eq "GET")
